analysis: Reviewed all supplied units. Changes: a new changelog fragment (changelog.d/landing-community-headlines.md, marketing copy and story-browsing UI notes), two added binary image assets (docs/assets/landing-community/hero.jpg and stories.jpg, with no content available), and a two-line addition to docs/developer/build.md (new lines 988-989) saying landing tests need jsdom, installed by `npm ci`. The patch hunk supplies only that documentation text, not the landing/package.json or package-lock.json changes. No runtime or security-relevant code is in the supplied diff: no coordinator, provider, attestation, App Attest, encryption, billing or authorization paths are touched. The threat-model assets and boundaries (TB-001..TB-011, T-0xx, A-0xx) are therefore not affected by the supplied changes. Coverage limits: the actual landing source (story gesture handlers, package.json, lockfile with jsdom) is not in this batch. A later pass should check that the jsdom devDependency is pinned in the lockfile and used only for tests, and that the story-browsing code does not add unsafe DOM sinks or external content loading. The binary images were not inspected, so any embedded content or metadata (e.g. EXIF/PII) is unverified. Nothing here warrants a finding.
